learning_outcomes.statement: The learner can construct and inspect paths with pathlib.Path, correctly distinguish absolute/relative paths and CWD from the script's own directory, and read/write text and binary files safely with explicit UTF-8 encoding using with.

The learner can choose an appropriate serialization format (JSON vs CSV vs plain text), use the json/csv modules correctly instead of naive string splitting, and apply a safe-save (temp-file-then-replace) pattern within a sandboxed working directory.
